AMENDMENT NO. 1 JANUARY 2016 
TO 
IS 15532 : 2004 PLASTICS CRATES FOR FRUITS AND 
VEGETABLES — SPECIFICATION 


(Page 4, Annex E) — Substitute the following for existing annex: 


‘ANNEX E 
(Clause 3.8.2) 


DETERMINATION OF RESISTANCE TO DROP 
E-1 BOTTOM DROP TEST 
E-1.1 Procedure 


E-1.1.1 Load a crate with dummies of the specified load capacity of the crate. 
Maintain the loaded crate at a temperature of 27 + 1 °C for a period of 24 h. 
Drop the loaded crate in horizontal position from a height of 3 m on a steel 
plate. Drop the crate four times and observe the cracks, or breakage or 
deformation occurred on the crate. The test is not valid, if full base of the crate 
is not impacted on each drop. 


E-1.1.2 Load a crate with dummies of the specified load capacity of the crate. 
Maintain the loaded crate at a temperature of 5 + 1 °C for a period of 24 h. Drop 
the loaded crate in horizontal position from a height of 3 m on a steel plate. 
Drop the crate four times and observe the cracks, or breakage or deformation 
occurred on the crate. The test is not valid, if full base of the crate is not 
impacted on each drop. 


E-2 CORNER DROP TEST 
E-2.1 Procedure 


E-2.1.1 Fill a crate with the dummies of the specified load capacity of the crate. 
Maintain the loaded crate at a temperature of 27 + 1 °C for a period of 24 h. 
Drop the crate from 30 cm height. Repeat the drop with other comers from the 
same height. Observe the breakage, cracks on the crate. 


E-2.1.2 Fill a crate with the dummies of the specified load capacity of the crate. 
Maintain the loaded crate at a temperature of 5 + 1 °C for a period of 24 h. Drop 
the crate from 30 cm height. Repeat the drop with other comers from the same 
height. Observe the breakage, cracks on the crate.’ 


(PCD 21) 
Publication Unit, BIS, New Delhi, India
